name: Saudi Jockey Club (JCSA)
via: established 1965; presidency entrusted by a Royal Decree of King Faisal Official name: Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia.
note: JCSA footer: 'established in 1965 and is tasked with the organisation, development and promotion of Saudi Arabian horseracing at domestic and international level'; its history page says a Royal Decree from King Faisal Bin Abdulaziz entrusted the presidency to Prince Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz.
